changelog:
Initial release of audience-of-one skill.

- Introduces a method to eliminate "AI flavor" in writing by ensuring every text answers three key questions: who is speaking, to whom, and why now.
- Focuses on restoring missing "coordinates" (speaker, audience, purpose), rather than just removing cliché phrases.
- Provides a workflow for diagnosing and rewriting AI-like text across scenarios (public posts, scripts, reports, tech docs, etc.).
- Emphasizes preserving factual details, technical information, and proper tone for context (e.g., technical documentation).
- Outputs either a rewritten version or diagnostic feedback, depending on user preference.
- Includes guidance for scoring and reviewing texts to ensure coordinates are clearly present.
summary: 去 AI 味，但不靠抓错词。核心判断：AI 味的根因是这段话没说给任何人听——模型产出"对所有人都成立"的平均句，也就是对谁都没用的句。方法是补回三个坐标（谁在说、对谁说、为什么非现在说不可），套话作为副产品自动消失。适配公众号/小红书/口播/社区/汇报/PRD/技术文档/邮件等场景，按场景换坐标。触发词：去AI...
